description: Handles the details of characteristics of all plants which includes specification like tolerence limits, followup frequency period for CPRI/IRPS calculation. A Characteristic may be either measure or defective type.
Manages every year industrial shift activities and shift timings for all Sectors. CPRI (or) IRPS calculation for Characteristics is based on Calendar activities

Measurements are provided as inputs for characteristics. One or more measures forms a Sample. A Sample can be deactivated or reintegrated. Based on tolerence specification of a characteristic, a Sample is decided as alert or valid
